scope: Source applicability plus synthetic native selection; no Beep task execution, hosted qualification or production performance claim.

nativeEvidence.publicProjection: Same decoded report values as the private execution receipt; JSON formatting only.

findings: On both frozen clients, absent and explicit false have the same selected sets and exit results in all six cases.
With only origin/main present, implicit GitHub main inference selects both fixture tasks by default and only the changed task with the flag enabled.
Explicit origin/main and exact commit SHA select only the changed task under all three flag settings, even when the GitHub event base name is unavailable.
An unavailable explicit base fails with exit 1 and the SCM-query error under every setting; it is not a successful empty selection or a conservative success.
When both implicit base refs are unavailable, every setting warns and selects all fixture tasks.
Within each fixed setting, changing base-selection inputs leaves the unchanged task input hash constant; no synthetic task was executed.

Reviewed automatic hosted callers pass --base with a fetched origin ref or BEEP_COVERAGE_BASE_SHA. CiLane exports that base as TURBO_SCM_BASE. The reviewed Quality review-fix/policy and Yeet final-check paths also pass explicit bases.
valueDecision: No additional selection reduction in the reviewed explicit-base path. The flag remains absent; no real CI timing or bill reduction is inferred from synthetic task counts.
reopenWhen: A named GitHub caller intentionally relies on native implicit base inference with remote-only refs; review source identity and measure that caller before changing configuration.
historicalAttempt: An initial assertion incorrectly expected an invalid explicit base to conservatively succeed. The failure remains private, the assertion was corrected to require SCM refusal, and the complete current-source matrix was re-executed.

Its --base flag is documented for the query proof; no automatic workflow/script caller was found in the reviewed source. It executes dry plans, not quality tasks.
